reframed_question: Under what conditions can an extinct-species proxy be scientifically feasible and conservation-defensible, and when must a proposal be rejected or deferred?
non_negotiable_invariants: Do not equate a proxy or hybrid with a recovered historical organism.
Do not claim that ancient DNA supplies an intact developmental system.
Do not propose or describe wet-lab, gestational, embryo-transfer, or release procedures.
Keep welfare, governance, and opportunity costs as non-compensatory constraints.
Use DESIGN_ONLY language and do not report observed biological results.
recommended_direction: Develop an uncertainty-aware, evidence-gated readiness assessment that can reject candidates even when genomic evidence is strong.
